title: Upper Savannah original tributary annual-reference comparison

source_interpretation.annualization_method: Use original ACTUAL for nitrogen/phosphorus in kg/year and ACTUAL_MT for sediment in metric tonnes/year. These are already annual calibration-target rates. Do not use PLOAD_TOTA/PLOAD_MT predictions or apply the model's TSS_CONV coefficient. The original regional FGDC metadata publishes a global target horizon 1999-10-01 through 2014-09-30; period_end is the exclusive 2014-10-01. This is source-global support, not an individual station sampling window, and rates are not multiplied by the horizon length.
notes: The regional targets describe 2012 reference conditions; current land cover and climate scenarios retain their distinct vintages.
Individual final estimator identity and target standard error are not exposed in this original mapper.
The reported 15-year horizon is source-global. Selected targets must not be presented as individual yearly measurements.
Suspended sediment 80154 and total suspended solids 00530 retain their original identity; the selection chooses one source series per catchment/native parameter.

target_horizon.meaning: Period covered by model calibration targets and some input variables

release.uncertainty: The original mapper does not publish target standard errors

source_interpretation.title: Upper Savannah — original tributary calibration targets

selection_policy.support: Original observation IDs with complete whole-catchment native support for every original baseline candidate; support selection never reads residuals or fit.
selection_policy.holdout: Hold the complete Chattooga geographic group out only when another retained geographic group supplies every positive-weight pollutant. Otherwise use all supported groups for a descriptive reference fit, with no held-out claim.
selection_policy.objective: Equal pollutant weights; original engine derives normalization from training groups only.
selection_policy.simulated_inputs: Generated terrain, land cover, climate or erosion layers remain simulated. A reference ranking does not establish real-catchment calibration or same-DEM gauge drainage alignment.
